xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4324: pan close DoD post-merge row trusts stored agent status: exited agents block every close-out

plan.title: pan close DoD post-merge row trusts stored agent status: exited agents block every close-out
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: checkPostMergeRow() in src/lib/lifecycle/dod-gate.ts filters agents on the stored state.json status (starting/running). That status is a spawn-time snapshot: work and planning agents that exit on their own keep 'running', so DoD row 5 reports 'running agents: agent-pan-<n>, planning-pan-<n>' and blocks nearly every pan close until the operator runs pan kill.
narratives.Proposal: Keep the role and claimed-live prefilter, then confirm each claimed-live agent with the liveness oracle (isAlive from src/lib/agents/liveness.ts) through a new required PostMergeRowDeps.isAlive seam. Agents confirmed dead (isConfirmedDead) no longer block and are named as 'stored running, not live'; alive agents block as 'running agents'; indeterminate or thrown probes block as 'liveness indeterminate'. The gate stays read-only. Document the rule in the close-out section of docs/MERGE-WORKFLOW.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Probing agents whose stored status is stopped or any other non-claimed-live status
- Writing stopped back to state.json, emitting events, or closing panes from the gate
- Special-casing Herdr alive panes with backendState idle or done as not running
- Changing any other DoD row, the row 5 definition text in src/lib/lifecycle/dod.ts, or pan close control flow
- Using tmuxActive or the runtime census as the liveness source
- Editing docs/TERMINAL-BACKENDS.md (its row 5 note is the PAN-3947 story)

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the stored starting/running prefilter and probe only claimed-live rows
autoDecisions.rationale: Mirrors deriveServedAgentStatuses from PAN-4320 (confirm claimed-live rows, pass others through) and avoids newly blocking issues whose agents pan kill stopped while a Herdr pane outlived the stop.

autoDecisions.summary: An indeterminate or thrown liveness probe counts as running (row misses)
autoDecisions.rationale: Same isConfirmedDead rule every remediator uses: a probe that cannot answer must never let close-out proceed.

autoDecisions.summary: An alive pane with Herdr backendState idle/done still counts as running
autoDecisions.rationale: Issue AC2 requires a live pane after merge to keep failing row 5; the post-merge handoff is responsible for closing those panes.

autoDecisions.summary: New PostMergeRowDeps.isAlive seam is required and returns the LivenessVerdict
autoDecisions.rationale: A verdict (not a boolean) lets the row report indeterminate separately; required (not optional-with-real-default) keeps unit tests off Herdr/tmux.

items.title: DoD row 5 confirms claimed-live agents with the liveness oracle

expected_outputs: tests/unit/lib/lifecycle/dod-gate.test.ts passes including the new PAN-4324 cases

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1 in .pan/drafts/pan-4324.md exactly. In src/lib/lifecycle/dod-gate.ts: import { isAlive, isConfirmedDead, type LivenessVerdict } from '../agents/liveness.js'; add required `isAlive: (agentId: string) => Promise<LivenessVerdict>` to PostMergeRowDeps (search 'interface PostMergeRowDeps') with a PAN-4324 doc comment; set `isAlive: agentId => isAlive(agentId)` in defaultPostMergeRowDeps. In checkPostMergeRow, rename the existing role+starting/running filter result to claimedLive, probe each with deps.isAlive(id).catch(() => ({ alive: false, reason: 'runtime-indeterminate' })) via Promise.all, split into runningAgents (verdict.alive), indeterminateAgents (!alive && !isConfirmedDead), exitedAgents (isConfirmedDead); blockingAgents = running + indeterminate. agentsObserved = 'running agents: <ids>' and/or 'liveness indeterminate: <ids>' joined by '; ', else 'no running work/planning agents' plus ' (stored running, not live: <ids>)' when any exited. Every branch that tested runningAgents.length === 0 now tests blockingAgents.length === 0. Do not use tmuxActive; do not write any state. In tests/unit/lib/lifecycle/dod-gate.test.ts: add isAlive seams to every existing checkPostMergeRow call (alive:true for running-agent cases), and add the six new cases listed in the PRD (no-session pass, alive miss, indeterminate miss, thrown probe miss, done+pane-dead pass, stopped not probed).
narrative.Hazard: dod-gate.ts is 962 lines and the file-size ceiling is 1000; keep the change compact. If scripts/lint-file-size.sh flags it, add '<lines> src/lib/lifecycle/dod-gate.ts # PAN-4324' to scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt in the same commit.

items.title: Given work and planning agents stored running and isAlive returning no-session, checkPostMergeRow returns status pass and observed contains 'no running work/planning agents' and 'stored running, not live: agent-pan-2715, planning-pan-2715'
Given a stored-running work agent and isAlive returning alive:true with backendState idle, checkPostMergeRow returns status miss and observed contains 'running agents: agent-pan-2715'

Given isAlive returning runtime-indeterminate or rejecting, checkPostMergeRow returns status miss with observed containing 'liveness indeterminate: agent-pan-2715' and not 'post-merge evidence unavailable'
Given an agent with stored status stopped, checkPostMergeRow does not call the isAlive seam (vi.fn spy has zero calls) and returns pass on verifying_on_main
npx vitest run tests/unit/lib/lifecycle/dod-gate.test.ts exits 0, and git grep -n tmuxActive src/lib/lifecycle/dod-gate.ts returns no matches
Document the DoD row 5 liveness rule in the close-out section
